# RPIR Stage Assurance

## Purpose and inputs

Provide independent, read-only advice on an actual working stage document, inspected predecessor/version when applicable, approved scope, original acceptance, validation and intended next action. Apply only relevant portions of the [stage assurance checklist](./stage-assurance-checklist.md). Assurance is useful when requested, not a mandatory per-unit gate or second approval.

Use the [handoff reliability scenario pairs](./handoff-reliability-scenarios.md) for a bounded semantic assessment when relevant. They are synthetic examples with recorded reasoning, not observed conversations, a new gate or permission to launch sessions.

The [four concise-output scenario pairs](./concise-output-scenarios.md) add report/chat examples for simple success, qualified decisions, partial delivery and unavailable sources. Assess their reasons against the shared rule and phase owners; they do not replace the eight handoff pairs or establish live readability improvement.

## Assessment

1. Compare claims of output, completed work, validation and preserved criteria with inspected evidence. Check the prospective schema proportionately; older records remain readable without migration or rewriting.
	Assess whether Research establishes an evidence-supported viable mechanism and decision-critical feasibility, with realistic alternatives and a recommendation distinct from actual engineer selections. Plan checks freshness/applicability and converts that conclusion into delivery; an inherited essential gap, architectural or not, or genuinely new requirements/evidence reopening feasibility needs an explained affected gap and recommended scoped engineer-directed Research continuation or supplementation where evidence is needed. Retain truthful drafts and independent supported work without retroactive blame, automatic restart or a readiness veto on manual invocation. For material residuals, assess the supported mechanism tested, why the fact reasonably remains and the existing bounded route; neither zero unknowns nor an inspection ban is warranted. Implement retains ordinary decisions, inspection, diagnosis, repair and recheck. See the [Research](../codebase-research/SKILL.md), [planning](../architecture-planning/SKILL.md) and [implementation](../safe-implementation/SKILL.md) methods for detail.
2. Verify real contained numbered physical predecessor relationships and direct same-folder lineage where applicable. For new Research, inspect documented root/parent/topic selection and actual non-overwriting physical output; do **not** demand routine engineer confirmation of a generated folder name. For a proposed write, check its actual containment and effective permission, not a compulsory command or repeated inventory ritual.
3. Distinguish ordinary in-boundary repair from material change requiring engineer choice. A failed local check may be diagnosed and rechecked; unresolved acceptance remains unmet. Inspect actual deliverable, not merely a saved report. For Review, classify severity, actionability/uncertainty and original-criteria correction/material change independently; supported corrections return manually to Implement under the original Plan with linked Review context and fresh independent Review.
	Assess complete architectural choice coverage against Research, the approved Plan and actual changes, including missing or partial coverage even when a valid ADR is bound. Check Research identification and Plan reconciliation of every choice, including planning discoveries; inspected reused/grouped records must preserve each choice's rationale, alternatives, selection/pending state, conditions and affected Work Items, not a vague umbrella record. For unexpected uncovered or changed architecture, advise engineer-directed Plan resolution before dependent architectural effects; continue independent approved work. Routine naming, helper extraction and architecture-preserving repairs remain Implement-owned without ADR reference; resolve material classification ambiguity with the engineer using evidence through the coordinator.
	When a Plan binds an ADR, advise whether its exact identity/section/preimage version/state/conditions and dependent work are traceable, and whether the report's actual invocation and per-record persistence claims match inspected ADR postimages. Do not infer `Accepted` from invocation alone or retroactive sign-off from an invocation predating effective policy. Confirm that Review distinguishes architectural agreement from delivery approval/acceptance and remains source-read-only. This remains advisory, grants no ADR authorship or status-write authority and does not create a phase-wide veto.
4. Report evidence-backed passed checks, defects, unavailable checks, residual risks and the smallest useful coordinator action. State which particular effect cannot proceed because of a real denial, unresolved material decision, ambiguous identity or uncertain destructive/external completion. Continue independent safe work; do not invent a phase-wide veto.

Apply the [shared reader-facing rule](../rpir-lifecycle-core/SKILL.md#reader-facing-outputs) to future phase-owned reports/chat. Concise linked evidence may replace repeated rationale/procedures, not required actions or material outcomes: keep actual answers/conditions, required failed/unavailable/not-run checks, consequential corrections/rechecks, unsaved tracking, every expected checkpoint disposition and exact per-record ADR invocation/recording outcomes. Omit irrelevant headings/empty categories and routine successful save narration. Inspect linked sources, sections and versions where material; unavailable sources need an affected-effect route. Do not infer chronology from final state, live effectiveness from samples/static passes, or acceptance with unresolved findings.

## Boundary

### Checkpoint coverage and accounting

Assess every prospective Plan for one explicit bounded strategy and every detailed Work Item for a strategy reference, normal post-validation boundary and coherent content/purpose, or a specific justified combination/deferral/no-commit exception under the [checkpoint capability](../local-git-checkpoints/SKILL.md). Exceptions identify actual constraint/reason, affected IDs, validation/dependency consequence, later boundary if one exists and why normal is unsuitable. Missing entries, empty headings, generic exemptions and unexplained blanket bans fail planning assessment; actual prohibitions, including historical Plans, still grant no Git authority. Do not invent future obstacles or require historical rewrites.

For Implement and Review, reconcile planned versus actual accounting at every expected boundary before unrelated work, including consideration of earlier coherent validated Tasks and actual disposition evidence. Identify omissions and unjustified departures; runtime obstacles belong in fresh implementation evidence, not retrospective substantive approved-Plan exceptions. Preserve distinct runtime outcomes and safeguards. Assess observed timely handling, observed late/omitted handling or unverified chronology, never a silence/final-history/marker-based pass. Commit count is not technical acceptance; a supported no-commit disposition is not defective delivery. This is advisory evidence assessment, not Git authority, a new approval gate or Plan amendment authority.

Do not edit, run commands, delegate, persist records, select scope, grant permission or decide acceptance. An engineer's explicit receiving invocation controls transition; an advisory opinion, draft, status marker or manual handoff does not. A verified clean Review, not assurance or an optional status mirror, records acceptance. Honest save/readback evidence is still required for any claimed physical record.
